category: isolated VM sandbox for short jobs

free_tier.stated: no recurring free allowance is published; pay-as-you-go is 6 US cents per compute-minute after a USD 10 minimum prepaid credit, where a compute-minute is one started minute of a Small sandbox (1 vCPU, 1 GB RAM)
free_tier.notes: Prepaid credit persists; optional monthly plans bundle 100, 400 or 1200 compute-minutes that reset on day 1 UTC and do not roll over. Queue and provisioning time are not billed. A job under one minute costs one compute-minute.

per_object_cap.stated: not an object-storage offer; job inputs are up to 8 root filenames combined 8 MB and each artifact export is at most 8 MB
per_object_cap.notes: The 8 MB figures are per transfer, not a sandbox disk cap.

retention.stated: exported artifacts remain after the VM is destroyed for 1 day on pay-as-you-go or Starter, 7 days on Pro and 30 days on Business; the VM itself is destroyed at job teardown

egress.terms: networking is offline only inside the VM, and monthly artifact downloads are 1 GB on PAYG or Starter, 5 GB on Pro and 15 GB on Business
egress.free_allowance: 1 GB of artifact downloads a month on PAYG and Starter

interface_detail: an HTTP API at https://sandbox.agnt.gg/sandbox/v1 with /jobs, /jobs/quote, /artifacts and /agents endpoints, an OpenAPI document, and JavaScript and Python job helpers; agents can sign up and fund themselves over HTTP
tooling: an HTTP client and a Bearer sandbox_ key; headless agent signup returns a secret, and funding is by a human claim link or x402 with USDC on Base
chaining: a bounded Python, Node or shell job runs in an isolated Kata-backed VM and exports selected files through the API, with a spend cap on each run; the offline guest has no inherited credentials, so outside data must be passed in as inputs.

limits.value: one started minute minimum per run, then started-minute rounding; default job 120 seconds, maximum 900 seconds
job inputs up to 8 root filenames combined 8 MB; each artifact transfer at most 8 MB
artifacts retained 1 day on PAYG and Starter, 7 days on Pro, 30 days on Business; monthly downloads 1 GB, 5 GB, 15 GB respectively
a USD 10 minimum prepaid top-up is required before a PAYG job can run, and every paid job needs a maxChargeMicroUSD spending cap

limits_note: A compute-minute is one started minute of a Small (1 vCPU, 1 GB) sandbox; Medium and Large consume 2 and 4 compute-minutes a minute. Guests have offline networking, no arbitrary images, no snapshots, no public ports and no inherited secrets. Current capacity is serial and queued, not reserved concurrency.
binding_note: A new account cannot run a job at all until prepaid credit is added; the USD 10 minimum top-up is the first gate a user meets, ahead of the per-minute charge.

identity_cost.detail: the docs say to create the Sandbox account with an email address, and no existing AGNT account or app subscription is required; an agent can sign up headlessly with no email or browser, receiving a secret shown once, and fund the account through a human claim link or x402 in USDC on Base. Prepaid execution needs no card; the docs say there are no automatic card charges.

reliability_note: Guests run offline with no network access and no inherited credentials. Capacity is serial and queued rather than reserved concurrency; a busy or absent worker rejects new admission. Customer-code failures and timeouts consume runtime; confirmed lost-worker failures on managed jobs are refunded.
confidence_note: the pricing page, llms.txt and docs page were read on 2026-11-25; the quoted lines establish the prepaid model, the per-minute rates, the signup gate and the artifact and network limits. No account, wallet funding or job was created, so the rung is documented rather than measured.

notes: The operator's provider list prices AGNT Sandbox at USD 6.00/h billed per minute; the vendor's published sizes are Small at 6 US cents a minute (USD 3.60/h), Medium 2 vCPU/2 GB at 12 cents a minute (USD 7.20/h) and Large 4 vCPU/4 GB at 24 cents a minute (USD 14.40/h). No free tier is published: the monthly Starter plan costs USD 5 and bundles 100 compute-minutes. The 2 vCPU/4 GB size in the list is not a published size.

shape.note: Small is the pay-as-you-go unit; Medium and Large consume 2 and 4 compute-minutes a minute

extras.billing_model: prepaid pay-as-you-go by started compute-minute, with optional monthly minute bundles
extras.price_arithmetic: 6 US cents per compute-minute for Small = USD 3.60 per hour (derived: 0.06 x 60); Medium 0.12 x 60 = USD 7.20 per hour; Large 0.24 x 60 = USD 14.40 per hour
extras.billing_note: the vendor publishes per-minute rates, not an hourly rate; the hourly figures here are arithmetic on the quoted rates

session_cap.note: default job 120 seconds, maximum 900 seconds; the VM is destroyed after job teardown

network_out.ports: no public ports; artifacts are fetched through the authenticated API
